title: Song of the Clan Ember
author: Old Mother Shurra Emberfang
pages: Carry the ember, carry the clan. Carry it over the red land. When the grandmothers fell at the Red Ford, the ember went on in a child's hand.
We are not the wolves the soft ones fear. We are the fire that keeps the cold away. Some of us raid and some of us trade, and all of us bring the dead home to stay.
Durzha Red-Ember broke the legions. Durzha Red-Ember brought them low. But Durzha wept when the river ran red, and laid her own sword in the flow.
Feed the ember, never let it die. Guest under the ember, never harm. Pay the ones who fight for you, or the ember-law will come to your farm.
And when I go down to the Ember Below, shout my name into the fire. I'll be there with the grandfathers, warm, and you'll see me in the sparks rising higher.
